title: Users
subtitle: Manage users and system access permissions.

COORDINATOR.name: Coordinator
COORDINATOR.description: Oversees and manages overall tenant operations and role assignments.

DATABASE.name: Database
DATABASE.description: Manages data records, participants, and tenant-wide reports.

CIRCUIT_SUPERINTENDENT.name: Circuit Superintendent
CIRCUIT_SUPERINTENDENT.description: Supervises circuits and congregations associated with the tenant.

ZONE-SUPERINTENDENT.name: Zone Superintendent
ZONE-SUPERINTENDENT.description: Manages assigned zones and oversees preaching locations.

KEY_MAN.name: Key Man
KEY_MAN.description: Main operational lead across locations and shifts in their zone.

KEY-MAN_ASSISTANT.name: Key Man Assistant
KEY-MAN_ASSISTANT.description: Assists the key man with logistics and shift supervision.

PLACE-MANAGER.name: Place Manager
PLACE-MANAGER.description: Responsible for location logistics, cart setup, and supplies.

CAPACITATOR.name: Trainer
CAPACITATOR.description: Conducts training sessions and evaluates readiness of new volunteers.

PARTICIPANT.name: Participant
PARTICIPANT.description: Active volunteer eligible to participate in scheduled shifts.
